Ad inizio primavera del 2021 inizio a trattare uno dei temi caldi per l'anno in questione: la sostituzione imminente delle composizioni EW III con i RABe 528 sia in Simmental che sull'IR66. Sulla prima delle due linee trascorriamo una soleggiata giornata di marzo, che inizia a Garstatt con il treno 4065 Interlaken Ost - Zweisimmen. 

Im Frühjahr 2021 beginne ich damit, mich mit einem der wichtigsten Themen des Jahres zu befassen: die bevorstehende Ersetzung von EW III-Kompositionen durch RABe 528 sowohl im Simmental als auch auf dem IR66. Auf der ersten der beiden Linien verbringen wir einen sonnigen Tag im März, beginnend in Garstatt mit dem Zug 4065 Interlaken Ost - Zweisimmen.

?? La grue Cokrill 85 T GF581 de Perrigny, est stationnée à Mulhouse-Nord, quelques mois avant son transfert vers Montluçon (12 décembre 2014).
.
Construite par les établissements Cockerill à Seraing en Belgique en 1945, à l'origine, cette grue fonctionnait à la vapeur. Elle a été dieselisée en 1970. Affectée Sucessivement à Tours puis à Villeneuve-St-Georges, elle a terminée sa carrière affectée à Perrigny, où elle a été retirée du service en 2007. Prévue initialement pour la Cité du rain, elle a finalement été mise à disposition de l'AATV Montluçon en 2015.

Returning for Deposits
Empty BNSF coal gondola heading back to Wyoming seen in Everett, Washington. The aluminum construction of the coal gondola is on display when viewed from above.

Transporting coal has been a major revenue source for railroads since their inception. Two major types of cars emerged for hauling coal; hoppers and gondolas. The earlier cars were made of wood, then steel, and later aluminum. The lighter weight of aluminum allows greater lading and cubic foot capacities ideal for bulk minerals transport. By the 1980s, both coal hoppers and coal gondolas were using aluminum bodies in their construction.
 
The aluminum coal gondola model represents a typical Association of American Railroads car type code J311, a gondola car with a load limit greater than 185,000 lbs, depressed bottom, and 36' to 48' interior length. Typical of these cars is the rotary coupler usually signified by a contrasting color on one or, both ends. The car has thirteen side stakes and a double tub

1970 Delta Yard
The Rogers Main runs between Delta Junction and PA Junction in Everett on former Northern Pacific Roadbed. In 2015, BNSF completed a large project around the Everett area to expand Delta and Bayside Yards. The WSDOT High-Speed Rail Corridor project, realigned the Rogers Main to connect with the Bayside Line, to reduce conflict with through trains waiting for commuter windows and a slot through the Everett tunnel.
 
As a part of the 2015 project, Marsh Yard (between Delta Yard and the Rogers Main was built. This added 4 arrival/departure tracks. Nee Delta classification tracks 13-16, plus a small stub track 17 were also added. Double track were added from Bayside Yard around the north tip of Everett to Delta Junction.
 
A 1970 BN track chart shows the former Northern Pacific roadbed used for the modernization project.

Im Frühjahr 1998 konnte ich die orientrote 181 213-0 mit einem Intercity bei der Durchfahrt in Karlsruhe-Durlach fotografieren. 
181 213-0 war eine von ursprünglich drei getauften Loks und trug den Namen «Saar». Zum selben Zeitpunkt im Oktober 1976 erhielten die beiden Loks 181 211-4 den Namen «Lorraine» und die 181 212-2 den Namen «Luxembourg». Erst im Jahr 1991 kam mit 181 214-8 eine vierte getaufte Lok dazu, die den Namen «Mosel» erhielt. 
Der Name war jeweils seitlich nach links versetzt auf einer Platte montiert zu lesen. 
Übrigens gab es nur eine Handvoll der 25 Serienloks, die die orientrote Lackierung erhielten. 

Analogfoto mit 35mm Film und Kleinbildkamera Pentax ME Super erstellt.

Wet Down. As the @amtrak Gulf Coast inspection train passes the historic depot in Tallahassee, Florida on 2/19/2016, the City of Tallahassee Fire Department came out to give the train a traditional fire suppression service "wet down". Crowds came out across four states to see the two day trip. Sponsored by Amtrak and the Southern Rail Commission as an inspection/demonstration trip, it was the first passenger train to travel this route since "Sunset Limited" service was suspended in 2005 due to Hurricane Katrina. Recently, Amtrak has started to operate qualification trains between New Orleans, Louisiana and Mobile, Alabama ahead of a return of daily service to this area but presently there are no active plans for this portion of the line.
